example.title: Will Donald Trump endorse Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 Brazilian presidential election before Oct 26, 2026?
example.rules_primary: If Donald Trump publicly endorses Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 Brazilian presidential election before Oct 26, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
example.rules_secondary:
An "endorsement" requires:
A clear, affirmative statement of support for candidate's election
The statement must be public (not private communications)
The endorsement must specifically reference the 2026 Brazilian presidential election or be clearly in context of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election
The endorsement must come directly from Donald Trump or through official channels

The following scenarios would resolve to YES:
Donald Trump states "I endorse candidate for [office]"
Donald Trump states "I support candidate" with clear reference to the 2026 Brazilian presidential election
Donald Trump states "I'm voting for candidate" publicly
Donald Trump states "candidate has my full support" for the 2026 Brazilian presidential election
Donald Trump appears at campaign events specifically to endorse
Donald Trump releases official endorsement through their organization
Donald Trump allows their name/image to be used in candidate's campaign materials

Statements of obvious sarcasm (or which are immediately followed by clarifications that Donald Trump is joking) are NOT encompassed by the Payout Criterion.

The Contract shall resolve immediately upon confirmation of the first qualifying endorsement in the specified race. If multiple candidates are listed for a listed race and exactly one is endorsed, that candidate's strike resolves "Yes" at $1.00 and all other named-candidate strikes resolve "No." If multiple are endorsed, each endorsed candidate's strike resolves "Yes" at a value of ($1.00 / N) rounded down to the nearest $0.01. 

If no endorsement occurs before expiration, the "No one" strike resolves "Yes" at $1.00 and all named-candidate strikes resolve "No."

If a candidate withdraws from, suspends their campaign for, ceases to be a candidate in, or loses the primary or general election for the specified race before a qualifying endorsement is confirmed, their strike may resolve to No in the sole discretion of the Exchange.

EXCLUDED EVENTS

“Excluded Event” means any event or circumstance arising from, or directly resulting from:

(i) Any act of unlawful interference with civil aviation, including sabotage, unlawful seizure of aircraft, or interference with air navigation facilities or services;

(ii) Any deliberate act or omission by any person, whether or not identified, undertaken with the purpose or reasonably foreseeable effect of disrupting operations at John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK/KJFK), including without limitation unauthorized unmanned aircraft operations, laser illumination, trespass upon or unauthorized presence within the air operations area, tampering with or destruction of airport, air carrier, air traffic control, or utility infrastructure serving John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK/KJFK), and false reports or threats resulting in evacuation, ground stop, or suspension of operations;

(iii) Any malicious cyber incident affecting systems of John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK/KJFK), any air carrier, or any air navigation service provider, as characterized by the affected entity or a governmental authority; or

(iv) Any security-related closure, ground stop, or operational suspension ordered by a governmental authority in response to an actual or suspected act described in clauses (i)–(iii) or to any actual or suspected act of unlawful violence, wherever occurring.

HOW THE CANCELLATION PERCENTAGE IS CALCULATED

The cancellation percentage is calculated by dividing the number of cancelled flights within the fixed schedule by the total number of scheduled flights and multiplying the result by 100. The result is carried to two decimal places without rounding; any digits beyond the second decimal place are truncated.

Schedule baseline: The schedule baseline for this market is October 19, 2026 at 11:59:59 PM ET.

Fixed scheduled-flight total: The binding total number of scheduled flights will be determined as of October 19, 2026 at 11:59:59 PM ET. This total consists of commercial passenger and cargo flights, including arrivals and departures combined, scheduled to operate at John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK/KJFK) during October 21, 2026.

The fixed total includes any flight subsequently cancelled and is not reduced by cancellations, schedule changes, or removals occurring after the schedule baseline. Flights added after the schedule baseline are excluded from both the scheduled-flight total and the cancellation count.

Cancelled flights: A flight counts as cancelled only if it is included in the fixed scheduled-flight total and is classified as cancelled by the Primary Source Agency as of the Expiration time. Cancellations made after the schedule baseline but before the beginning of October 21, 2026, including pre-emptive cancellations, are counted.

Reinstated flights: A flight initially classified as cancelled that is subsequently reinstated and operates during October 21, 2026 is not counted as cancelled.

Excluded flight outcomes: Delayed flights, diverted flights, and gate returns that ultimately depart are not counted as cancelled, regardless of the length of the delay.

Corrections and revisions: Corrections, retractions, or restatements made by the Primary Source Agency before Expiration will be considered. Revisions made after Expiration will not be considered.

Local time and flight attribution: All dates and times relating to the scheduling and operation of flights are interpreted in the local time of John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK/KJFK) unless otherwise specified. Each flight is attributed to October 21, 2026 according to its originally scheduled date of operation at the airport.

AIRPORT CLOSURE

If John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK/KJFK) is fully closed and no scheduled flight operates for the entirety of October 21, 2026, the cancellation percentage will be deemed 100.00%.

If the scheduled-flight total is zero because the airport is closed, or has been ordered or announced to be closed, for the entirety of October 21, 2026, the cancellation percentage will be deemed 100.00%. If the scheduled-flight total is zero for any other reason, the outcome will be determined pursuant to Rule 7.1 of the Rulebook.

example.rules_primary: If the daily published par yield for the 10Y U.S. Treasury is below 5.03% on any business day between Oct 16, 2026 and Oct 23, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
example.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
This market covers the period between Oct 16, 2026 and Oct 23, 2026.
Resolution is based solely on the Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rate for the 10Y tenor as published by the U.S. Department of the Treasury for each business day in this period; intraday values are not considered.
The first published value for each business day governs unless the Exchange determines a material error prior to that strike's expiration. 

Expiration
If the threshold is met, the market may expire early in accordance with Rule 7.2.
Otherwise, the market will expire by 7:00 PM ET on the first business day after the final daily value of the period is published, or one week after the period ends, whichever comes first.

example.rules_primary: If CISA announces the addition of CVE-2026-109618 to the KEV catalog before Oct 26, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
example.rules_secondary:
The KEV catalog is CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog at https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog, which CISA also publishes as a JSON feed. CVE-2026-109618 is one of the two PHP vulnerabilities known as PHP2Shell.

The addition counts on the Date Added that the catalog records for CVE-2026-109618. A later removal of the entry does not change a resolution already made.

The following do NOT resolve this market to YES:
An entry for CVE-2026-109619 alone.
A CISA alert, advisory or statement urging organizations to patch the vulnerability.
A CISA statement that it has or has not observed exploitation.
A report of exploitation by anyone other than CISA.

example.title: Mortgage applications change above −8% in the next MBA report?
example.rules_primary:
If the the percentage change in the seasonally adjusted Market Composite Index in the first MBA Weekly Applications Survey release after market Issuance is above 

-8%, then the market resolves to Yes.
example.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the first-published percentage change in MBA’s seasonally adjusted Market Composite Index in the first new Weekly Applications Survey results release after market Issuance. All strikes use the same release, including strikes added later.

The reported change is used directly, including holiday adjustments and regardless of the comparison period; no calculation is required. If separate changes are reported for multiple reference weeks, the latest reference week controls. Increases are positive, decreases negative, and unchanged is 0%. “Above” means strictly greater than the strike.

Later revisions, corrections, and subsequent releases are ignored. If publication is delayed, trading remains closed pending the qualifying release, subject to the latest expiration and the contract’s missing-data provisions.

example.title: Will at least 3,000,000 people vote in the first round of Bulgaria’s 2026 presidential election?
example.rules_primary: If at least 3,000,000 valid and invalid ballots, in combination are cast in the first round of the 2026 Bulgarian presidential election, then the market resolves to Yes.
example.rules_secondary:
The count is the total of valid votes (including “I do not support anyone” votes) and invalid ballots in the first round of Bulgaria’s 2026 presidential election, as published by the Central Election Commission (CIK), including sections abroad. Registered voters, voter-list signatures and the second round do not count.

Subject to the contract’s Fully-Conducted Elections and Accelerated Resolution Upon Designated Media Source Declarations provisions, the vote count refers to the officially certified results from the relevant election authority. Provisional, absentee, early, mail-in, or electronic ballots are included only if reflected in the official certification.

The contract resolves based on officially certified results regardless of ongoing appeals. Outside those two contract provisions, preliminary counts, exit polls, projections, or uncertified results do not qualify.

example.title: Will the bloc of Likud, Otzma Yehudit, RZP-Zehut, Amcha Yisrael, United Torah Judaism, and Shas hold the most seats in the Knesset after the 2026 Israeli legislative election?
example.subtitle: :: Likud, Otzma Yehudit, RZP-Zehut, Amcha Yisrael, UTJ, Shas
example.rules_primary: If the bloc of Likud, Otzma Yehudit, RZP-Zehut, Amcha Yisrael, United Torah Judaism, and Shas holds the most total seats in the Knesset following the 2026 Israeli legislative election, then the market resolves to Yes.
example.rules_secondary:
Rankings are determined by total seat count after the election, including seats not contested. A seat is won when the candidate is declared elected by the electoral authority and either the challenge period has expired, legal challenges are resolved, or the member has taken their seat. Party affiliation is based on the party under which the candidate was elected, regardless of later changes. In case of ties for a rank, all tied parties at that rank resolve to Yes with values split proportionally. If a ranking is skipped due to ties (e.g., two parties tie for #1, next is #3), markets for the skipped rank (#2) resolve to No.

The two blocs are ranked against each other. Each bloc's seat total is the combined number of seats won by the lists named for it, including all seats won by a named joint list. Seats won by any other list count toward neither bloc, and surplus-vote agreements and post-election coalitions do not change either bloc's total. Amcha Yisrael means the list led by Ofer Winter, also reported as People of Israel. If both blocs win the same number of seats, both markets resolve to Yes at $0.50.

example.title: Will it be reported by any of the Source Agencies that the Kennedy Center's main building reopens to the public before Oct 22, 2026?
example.rules_primary: If the Kennedy Center's main building reopens to the public after Issuance and before Oct 22, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
example.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

The main building is the Kennedy Center's original riverfront building, which houses the Concert Hall, Opera House, Eisenhower Theater, Terrace Theater and Grand Foyer. The REACH, the grounds, the plaza and the parking garage are not part of the main building. The name the building carries does not matter.

The main building reopens to the public when members of the general public are admitted inside it for a performance, event, tour or visit. Reopening any part of the main building is enough, and there is no minimum duration.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Programming at the REACH, on the grounds or at other venues
Access limited to staff, contractors, inspectors, officials, press, donors or invited guests
A private or invitation-only event
An announcement, court order or decision that the main building will reopen, before it actually reopens

This market does not refer to the LEI index level, its six-month change or diffusion index, the Coincident Economic Index, or the Lagging Economic Index.
